final._notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

card_product.name: Axis Bank Atlas Credit Card
card_product.point_value_baseline_basis: Axis Bank states that 1 EDGE Mile is equal to ₹1 when redeemed through the applicable Axis Travel EDGE redemption mechanism.

eligibility_engine.notes: Axis Bank publishes indicative eligibility criteria but states that the bank reserves the right to approve or decline applications. Primary cardholder age is 18-70 years, applicant must be a resident of India, and indicative net annual income is ₹12 lakh for salaried applicants and ₹15 lakh for self-employed applicants. These are not treated as contractually enforceable underwriting rules.
required_documents: Latest payslip / Form 16 / Income Tax Return copy as income proof
Residence proof such as passport, driving licence, electricity bill or landline telephone bill

reward_redemption_fee.notes: ₹99 per redemption transaction on the EDGE portal. A separate ₹199 fee applies for each conversion/transfer of EDGE Miles to partner loyalty programs.

annual_fee_waiver.evaluation_condition: There is no published annual-fee waiver for the Atlas card. Instead, eligible cardholders receive annual EDGE Miles after successful payment of the ₹5,000 + GST annual fee.

welcome_and_renewal_gift.trigger: First successful transaction within 37 days from card issuance for cards sourced from 20 April 2024 onwards.
welcome_and_renewal_gift.condition: Welcome benefit is available only once and only for paid cards. It is not applicable after cancellation and subsequent reopening of the same card variant.

additional_data._notes: Source-supported data that cannot be represented faithfully by any existing universal schema field. Do not duplicate data already represented elsewhere.

items.value: After successful payment of the ₹5,000 + GST annual fee, Gold tier receives 2,500 EDGE Miles and Platinum tier receives 5,000 EDGE Miles; Silver tier receives none.

value.cards_sourced_2022-12-20_to_2024-04-19: 5,000 EDGE Miles after one transaction within 30 days of issuance
value.cards_sourced_before_2022-12-20: 5,000 EDGE Miles after three transactions within 60 days of issuance

value.direct_airline_definition: Airline-owned websites, airline counters and airline helpline numbers.
value.travel_agents_and_otas: Bookings through travel agents, corporate travel agents, online travel agencies or their websites/IVR systems receive only the standard 2 EDGE Miles per ₹100.

value.cap_basis: Customer ID and calendar year, 1 January to 31 December.

value.partner_membership_ids: Only one loyalty ID may be linked per partner at a time.

value.crediting_time: EDGE Miles may take up to 12 days from the eligible transaction date to reflect.
value.emi_conversion: EDGE Miles are debited when a credit-card transaction is converted to EMI; cancellation of the EMI does not restore the miles for the original transaction.
value.closure_forfeiture: From 1 October 2025, unredeemed EDGE Miles may be forfeited 30 days after card closure.
value.overdue_forfeiture: Unredeemed EDGE Miles may be forfeited when the minimum amount due remains outstanding for more than 90 days.

value.railway_ticket_surcharge: As prescribed by IRCTC / Indian Railways
value.returned_payment_or_auto_debit_reversal: 2% of payment amount subject to minimum ₹500
value.late_payment_additional_consecutive_mad_: Additional ₹100 when Minimum Amount Due is missed for two consecutive cycles; continues each payment cycle until MAD is cleared.

items.value: The published fuel surcharge is 1% and is refunded for fuel transactions between ₹400 and ₹4,000, subject to a maximum benefit of ₹400 per statement cycle. Axis notes that certain fuel transactions may be charged by the fuel merchant/acquirer as ₹10 + GST instead of 1% + GST.

value.contractual_status: Indicative only; Axis Bank retains final approval discretion.
